purpose: Keep the source .wave + .section 24px reduced top rhythm separate from base FAQ/CTA layout and apply it only after the revised expectations->FAQ wave is rendered and proven.
depends_on: fresh same-browser source/target vertical geometry at the expectations->FAQ boundary
decision_rule: Measure from the bottom/visual end of the wave to the FAQ eyebrow/H2 and compare source vs target at desktop and <=720.
If target already matches source after wave4, record no-op PASS and do not append section-spacing-v001.
Only if target remains exactly source-contract-too-tall by the wave-adjacent section rhythm should section-spacing-v001 be appended as one uniquely marked page-local block.
After append, immediately re-measure the same boundary and ensure no negative overlap/clipping or CTA shift.
why_not_base_payload: The source reduced top padding is conditional on a preceding .wave. Applying it before wave4 is live/proven can create a 24px top-gap error. Historical wave evidence explicitly warned not to bundle this reduction blindly.
rollback: Remove only the post-wave spacing marker block from style#af-page256-parity if live geometry regresses.
